reviews.title: Cross words
reviews.text: Since the last iOS update the daily crossword puzzles have become impossible to do as the keyboard does not pop up. Surely an app update is well overdue?

reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text: Frequently fails to download often at weekends when the office is closed. No response to emails when trying to ask for support.

reviews.title: Rubbish, Don’t Subscribe!
reviews.text: What a load of rubbish. No paper again. What’s going on? Mornings are when most people like to keep on top of the current news stories — not with The Mirror, you’d be lucky to get the front and/or back page. I’m not even going to give it a rating! OK, one star

reviews.title: Faulty download again
reviews.text: This is happening at least once a week now where the days paper does not download.  Starting to lose patience and ready to cancel subscription

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: Again NO issue available, having to wait for some employee to turn up for work and reboot their server. It’s time a refund was provided when an issue is unavailable, some need to download it early then go to work.

reviews.title: Not available
reviews.text: Not always available last week couldn’t get the paper for 1 day this week still not working can only get the first page and the last page what’s going on
